components.css: :host{--bg:#f3eee2;--card:#fffcf5;--ink:#1e2740;--muted:#5d6377;--line:#e0d8c6;--mark:#ffdf6b;--bubble:#eee8d9;--me:#2f6fed;--tabs:#dcd3bd;--spring:cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1);--out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:Figtree,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-pin{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 15px 5px 5px;font:13.5px Figtree,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 12px 22px -14px rgba(30,39,64,.6);transition:transform .3s var(--spring),box-shadow .25s} .ds-pin .n{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 72%,#000);transition:transform .35s var(--spring)} .ds-pin .pd{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500} .ds-pin:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 26px -16px rgba(30,39,64,.7)} .ds-pin:hover .n{transform:scale(1.12) rotate(-6deg)} .ds-pin:active{transform:scale(.96);transition-duration:.08s} .ds-pin:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--mark);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: :host{--bg:#f3eee2;--card:#fffcf5;--ink:#1e2740;--muted:#5d6377;--line:#e0d8c6;--mark:#ffdf6b;--bubble:#eee8d9;--me:#2f6fed;--tabs:#dcd3bd;--spring:cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1);--out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:Figtree,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)} .ds-phone{width:280px;border:10px solid var(--ink);border-radius:46px;background:var(--card);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(30,39,64,.55);transform:rotate(-2deg)} .ds-phone .hd{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:36px 0 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px} .ds-phone .hd::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:88px;height:22px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--ink)} .ds-phone .msgs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;padding:10px 12px 16px} .ds-phone .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 -2px 4px} .ds-phone .who i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%} .ds-phone .b{max-width:86%;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:18px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.38;animation:ds-pop .45s var(--out) backwards} .ds-phone .out{align-self:flex-start;background:var(--bubble);border-bottom-left-radius:5px} .ds-phone .in{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--me);color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:5px} .ds-phone .ex{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;padding-top:6px} @keyframes ds-pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px) scale(.96)}}

narrative.overview:
A watercolor campus on cream paper, written over in ink navy, with one highlighter for what matters. Five crew members (Crew Lead, Scout, Tutor, Planner, Nudger) are stationery with faces, each carrying one color that follows it everywhere: its character, its map pin, its "who" dot above a bubble, its selected state. The iMessage thread is the product, so a tilted, ink-framed phone is the recurring hero object.

The tone is calm and tactile: paper cards with hairline borders, soft diffuse shadows, and controls that lift when you point at them and sink when you press. Density is relaxed; bands breathe. The same tokens drive three surfaces: the dashboard (`apps/web/app/globals.css`, `crew.tsx`), the pitch page (`apps/site/styles.css`), and the tap-to-open card pages (`apps/cards/app/cards.css`). When one changes, change all three.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, paper cards, ink type and ink primary buttons.
One highlighter yellow, used as a marker stroke, never as a fill for surfaces.
Five crew colors, one per specialist, used for identity only.
Fraunces for display, Figtree for everything you read or press.
Press feel: spring overshoot on hover lift, fast sink on press.
Painted places (campus, library, seminar desk) faded into the ground with masks and washes, never framed as photos.

rules.name: The One Color Per Crew Rule
rules.body: Each specialist owns its hue on every surface; never reuse a crew color for decoration or for a different agent.

rules.name: The Marker Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Highlighter appears as a stroke under text (roughly the lower 35-40% of the line) or as an outline, not as a background for cards or buttons.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for headings, quotes, and display numerals only; anything you tap is Figtree.

rules.name: The Respond-Don't-Decorate Rule
rules.body: Static surfaces get a hairline, not a shadow; shadows grow only on objects that float or are being touched.

dos: **Do** label every example thread and example data set on the surface itself ("Example conversation, in Syl's real wording", "Example data below"); never imply a replay is live.
**Do** give each crew member its own color on every surface, darkened to 72% with black behind white numerals.
**Do** use the spring curve for hover lift and a 70ms sink for press on anything clickable.
**Do** fade paintings into the cream ground with washes and masks.
**Do** keep tokens in sync across `apps/web`, `apps/site`, and `apps/cards`.
donts: **Don't** use the highlighter as a surface fill or a button color.
**Don't** put Fraunces on buttons, pins, or labels.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked labels above headings; headings stand on their own.
**Don't** use glyph characters (arrows, check marks) as icons; draw them as SVG.
**Don't** show live student data on the public site; it is examples only.
